source: Hand-computed synthetic reliability records from ADR-0026
subset_description: Five synthetic, non-overlapping records: two sustained events, two momentary events, and one zero-duration event. The served-customer count is 1000 and the reporting period is 24 hours.
citation: ADR-0026, decision 10. The definition target is IEEE Std 1366-2022; these records are not IEEE source data.
notes: This fixture provides specification and regression checks, not external validation. The download_date is the fixture creation date; no external dataset was downloaded. Checksum covers events.json bytes only.
